key.name: update-mode
key.summary: When Software looks for updates by itself
key.description: "wifi": when it starts and when apps change, on a network that does not count the data; "always": on any network; "never": only when asked (Mine's Check for updates). Software never installs updates by itself: they are installed from Mine.

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: "system" follows the system's scheme; "light" and "dark" are Software's own.

key.name: recent-searches
key.summary: The last searches, the newest first
key.description: Shown under the search field before anything is typed; at most eight.
